title: Army kills 2 NPA rebels, seizes arms in separate Eastern Visayas ops

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Two suspected New People’s Army (NPA) members were killed in a military operation in Dolores, Eastern Samar, while a separate operation in Northern Samar led to the recovery of firearms and an anti-personnel mine, the military reported. The 52nd Infantry Battalion said troops encountered NPA members in the hinterlands of Barangay Jicontol, Dolores, early on Oct. 28, resulting in the deaths of two rebels and the recovery of two high-powered firearms. The operation followed information from residents about the presence of armed rebels allegedly planning extortion activities in farming communities, the battalion said.
